ARTICLE XVII
FAVORED NATIONS CLAUSE

Should the Union at any time hereafter enter into an agreement with any major employer (Safeway, Lucky Stores D/B/A Eagle Bounty) the same agreement be used as the Employer business signatory hereunto written within Harris County surveyed the best Employer with the terms and conditions more advantageous to such other employee than is provided for in this Agreement, then the Employer, party to this Agreement, shall be provided with similar or such advantageous terms and conditions.

ARTICLE XVIII
SAVINGS CLAUSE

Should any part or provision of any provision herein contained be rendered or deemed or declared invalid by reason of any existing or subsequently enacted legislation or by decree of a court of competent jurisdiction, such invalidation of such part or portion of this Agreement shall not affect the validity of the remaining portions hereof and they shall remain in full force and effect thereinafter.

ARTICLE XIX
STORE CLOSING

A. In the event the Employer closes a store and some employees are terminated as a result sevenday notice and severance pay and severance pay true to one % (one%) week's pay for each year of continuous service, commencing with the (3rd) year of continuous service for employees up to 10yr, but not to exceed eight (8) weeks' pay at their regular rate. However, those employees who semoga’s [sic] have been employed less than three years as an employee will receive pro rata severance pay for that years as follows:
* 0-3 months equals twenty five percent (25%) of a week's pay
* 3-6 months equals thirty five percent (50%) of a week's pay
* 6-9 months equals seventy five percent (75%) of a week's pay
* Over 9 months equals one (1) week's pay
Severance pay shall be computed on the average hours worked per week for the fifty-two (52) weeks preceding a voluntary layoff or termination.

B. Employees terminated as a result of store closing shall receive in addition to severance pay pro rata vacation pay.
The Employer shall continue contributions to the Pension and Health and Welfare Trust Fund for three (3) full months following termination for store employees who receive severance pay, except those employees who secure employment with a competing Employer including severance pay in the Pension and Health Welfare Trust fund.

D. All monies due employees including severance pay shall be paid in a lump sum payment.
E. The Employer agrees to give the employees and the Union four (4) weeks' notice of advance in the event of a store closing or sale. When such notice is given, an employee shall remain with the Employer until the store closes or forfeits the rights under this Article unless mutually agreed to by the employee, Employer and Union.

F. No benefits shall accrue under the terms of this Article, unless the Employer makes a business decision to close or sell a store. If a store is abolished by case incendio, fire storm, land condemnation, or remodeling, then this Article shall not apply.

G. No benefits shall accrue under the terms of this Article if the employee resigns before arriving within a seventy-five (75) mile radius.
Any employee who is terminated and who is eligible for and accepts, severance pay, forfeits all seniority and recall rights. An employee who does not accept severance pay shall retain his recall rights for a period of six (6) months, and if still not recalled by the Employer, then she shall receive his severance pay and has no further recall rights.

ARTICLE XX
INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT (IRA)

The Employer agrees to deduct from the wages of its employees those amounts designated by them and to remit of such amounts deducted to a single individual retirement account such account to be established. This deduction and establishment of this account not to be co cost to the Employer other than the normal cost of payroll deduction.

ARTICLE XXI
DURATION

A. This Contract shall become effective as of November 20, 1983, and shall continue in full force and effect through November 22, 1986, and shall be automatically renewed and extended from year to year thereafter, unless either party serves notice in writing on the other party at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration date or anniversary date thereforeafter, of a desire to terminate or change this Contract.

B. This Contract, when executed, shall be defined to mean the wages, hours and rates of pay and other conditions of employment of the employees covered by this Contract for the term of the Contract, and no new or additional agreements shall be valid unless approved hereby to be subject to the negotiation during the termination her term.

C. All of the agreed upon changes and revisions in the Agreement will be effective as of the first (1st) Monday following the ratification of the new Agreement unless otherwise specifically provided for by the Agreement in effect.
